RESULT [continual]: YOLOv8n, 100 epochs per task: on VOC 15p1, fine-tuning scores 3.0 mAP, YOLO LwF+OCDM 60.7 and joint training 78.5. On COCO 40p10 the same three score 2.9 / 23.5 / 37.3. That is +2.1 and +2.9 over the previous best, but still 13.8 to 17.8 mAP below joint training.
US [continual]: This is the only method built for the Ultralytics YOLO head the trainer uses (YOLO26x/YOLO11). If the trainer ever has to add a new species without re-reading the whole pool, this is the loss to copy. Its honest lesson for us is the gap to joint training.
